slot_note: OS13's world (a public charging coverage figure) set aside: its decoy-era mechanism is a site-unit reading and its government office collides with task310's org family; the number moves to survey research, never built against Opportunity Sizing
niche: a university survey research centre placing a foundation-funded boost of 1,200 extra completed interviews in one of five health regions of a provincial household medicines survey's 2027 wave, each area worked to a fixed take, sized by the share of the region's 2027 standard error the boost removes
analyst_test: A strong analyst who joins both contractors' exports, attaches the weights through the ministry's concordance and reproduces the published 2025 design effects puts each region's published intraclass correlation into Kish's factorisation of the design effect, projects it at the boosted average take with the weighting effect held, and funds Lakeshore, while the equal boost quadruples the Central Valley supplement's take and narrows its weights.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the standard error a two-stage weighted cluster sample will give a regional estimate once every area's take is raised, which survey sampling projects from each area's weight share and take and the between-area and within-area variance; put hospital beds for interviews and there are no areas, weights, takes or sampling error for the projection to act on.
layer1: two fieldwork contractors' case exports with different code frames, date formats and layouts
a 2024 health-region reorganisation renumbering every survey area, the weights table still on the old numbers
partial and proxy interviews carried under disposition codes
refusals reissued under new case numbers
addresses withdrawn once an area's fixed take is reached
don't-know, refused and no-prescription answers on the item
stakeholder_role: the director of a university survey research centre, placing the 2027 boost the foundation funds

world.org_type: a university survey research centre running a provincial health survey

driver: The precision an equal addition to every group buys is set by how the present error divides among the groups and how the addition reshapes the weight each record carries, so holding the present error's weighting factor fixed while raising every group's size funds a group whose error barely moves and misses the one whose small groups the addition multiplies.
driver_concrete: Each region's 2027 standard error is projected area by area from its weight shares, its boosted takes and the between-area and within-area parts its published intraclass correlation sets; the Central Valley's supplement areas carry a third of its households on five interviews an area, so an equal boost quadruples their take and narrows the weights, while Kish's projection with the weighting effect held funds Lakeshore and count scaling funds the clustered North.
stump: A competent analyst puts each region's published intraclass correlation into Kish's factorisation of its 2025 design effect, projects the design effect at the boosted average take with the weighting effect held and funds Lakeshore; but an equal boost quadruples the take of the Central Valley's heavily weighted supplement areas and narrows its weights, so projected area by area the boost removes the largest share of the Central Valley's error.

differentiation.task240: task240 corrects a published estimate's current error for weights scaled to known counts; this build projects the error a changed take will give, through the weights the take itself reshapes
differentiation.task269: task269 (lineage) projects a test's reliability from examiner variance; this build projects a survey estimate's sampling error under added interviews inside fixed areas
